description: This Java source file defines the AttributesModified class which models an event indicating that all attributes of a 'Thing' have been modified. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and comparison. It serves as part of an event-driven system related to 'Things' in Eclipse Ditto.

classes.name: AttributesModified
classes.description: Final, immutable class representing an event where all attributes of a Thing have been modified. Provides methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: AttributesModified.of
methods.description: Constructs a new AttributesModified instance with explicit parameters including ThingId, Attributes, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata.

methods.name: AttributesModified.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AttributesModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the event data.

methods.name: getModifiedAttributes
methods.description: Returns the Attributes object representing the modified attributes.
